verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas runs a cloud-hosted Editor that stores user projects, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for this product. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting or contractual commitment about excluding user data from AI model training. Self-hosting downloads and private-project plans are adjacent features, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
